repair_findings_addressed.change: Strict bounded JSON, fixed-width hex and node-key-hash validation, signed freshness/TTL checks including provider-request TTL expiry, replay eviction, rate/concurrency limits, and exact ExpectedSourceIP-bound tcp4 dialing.

Agent-side RCT1 rows persist deterministic receipt ids and deadlines before ACK, with restart retry and bounded sweeps retained in the transferred localstate probe surface; controller-side semantic receipt replay was not expanded in this ownership-boundary card.

Legal CAS transitions reject agent self-publication of OPEN_FROM_VANTAGE; provider failures, malformed or contradictory evidence, missing provider artifacts, and expiry become explicit terminal outcomes.
Active-operation cap, cancellable expiry/result sweeper, terminal tombstone GC, operation-deadline HTTP context, bounded response bodies, and manager worker shutdown prevent orphan work.

Verified joins atomically publish a validated frozen orthogonal snapshot only after provider/WAN1/ACK1/RCT1 evidence and operation/node/provider bindings pass; generation resets clear old evidence, while localstate activation-event persistence remains a downstream Agent repair item.
Agent/controller writers serialize sequence allocation plus websocket writes; session goroutines have explicit Wait ownership and parent-context dispatch.

Controller forward/spec/desired-outbox/idempotency creation now uses a single BEGIN IMMEDIATE bundle with rollback-safe side effects, durable replay of identical requests, conflict on mismatched reuse, and expiry auditing; the durable control outbox/inbox now serializes claims, preserves bindings, and fences receipt phases; no frozen contract changed.
Providers have explicit independent_vantage metadata; local fixtures are false and cannot create OPEN evidence.
Controller uses configured net.Listen family and has IPv6 startup/dial regression coverage.
Migration 0005 adds independent-vantage metadata; terminal probe evidence is deleted before terminal tombstones after the sweeper retention window, and late writes fail closed.
Walking-skeleton fixtures no longer claim a provider join; five direct-v4 runs pass while strict policy tests prove NO_INDEPENDENT_VANTAGE.

Strict regressions cover source binding, provider-request TTL expiry, self-publish rejection, legal/unknown-field snapshots, atomic forward rollback/replay/conflict, contradictory evidence, tombstone GC, and IPv6; full race/check/build/cross-build checks pass.
